About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. description:
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

This position is ultimately accountable for P&L in a new product line.

Responsibilities

    • Market structure

    • Liquidity provision, clearing & settlement

    • On-chain vs. off-chain integrations

    • Identity and KYC/AML

    • Regulatory reporting

  • Direct technical product management and Engineering, both dedicated project resources and cross-team dependencies, to ensure rapid, coordinated delivery of the new product

  • Develop and own relationships with early design partners & ecosystem partners

title: Business Development Director – Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE)
Working Student
description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change, and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations: Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain, with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we are bolting on, it is central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we are heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations.

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused.

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes.

Who You Are

You are studying for a master's degree and want to see how a remote-first technology company really runs day to day. You like variety: one day might be a customer's supplier questionnaire, the next a recurring task you're automating with Claude. You enjoy working out how a process works and then making it better.

You work independently and in a structured way, and you're comfortable asking questions and working with Security, Legal and Finance to get something done. You care about the details, because supplier registrations and internal records need to be right. You're curious about AI and automation tools, and you want to use them on real work instead of just reading about them.

title: Senior Product Manager, Panel (Remote, EU/UK)
description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

What you’ll do

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

  • Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

  • Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

  • Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

  • Improving training stability at multi-node scale

  • Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

  • Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency<

title: Lead Architect - Digital Assets
description:
We are hiring on behalf of our client, an established, leading European regulated financial institution who is expanding its digital assets capabilities to build the next generation of financial market infrastructure. The organization is seeking a Lead Architect – Digital Assets to lead a zero-to-one build, bridging traditional capital markets with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This mandate involves architecting the core platform behind initial tokenised offerings across two major live initiatives currently in design:

  1. Tokenised Issuance, Trading, and Settlement Platform: Supporting equities, ETFs, and bonds with a 24/7 central limit order book, fractional trading, CCP-cleared trades, and end-of-day atomic DvP settlement on-chain.
  2. Tokenised Collateral-Management Platform: Designed for sovereign bonds to enable real-time repo, CCP-margin eligibility, and DeFi distribution of government securities through gated lending venues.

  • On-Chain Compliance & Governance: Define regulatory compliance frameworks on-chain, utilizing regulated security-token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX), KYC-whitelisted wallets, automated transfer restrictions, real-time AML screening (Chainalysis / Elliptic), and transaction reporting under MiFIR.
  • Custody & Key Management: Architect robust custody models around MPC solutions (e.g., Fireblocks, Taurus), incorporating hybrid frameworks to support bring-your-own-custody (BYOC) for institutional clients.
  • Security & Quality Standards: Establish code quality, code review, testing, and secure-by-design standards. Conduct threat modelling and lead security architecture prior to onboarding a dedicated security lead.
  • AI-Augmented Software Delivery: Define, implement, and govern an AI-assisted software delivery process using coding assistants, smart-contract scaffolding, and AI-generated test suites while enforcing strict risk and review guardrails.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Ein unternehmensweites Cryptographic Inventory konzipieren und strukturieren sowie erfassen, wo RSA, ECC, DH und weitere kryptografische Verfahren in Anwendungen, Infrastruktur, Netzwerken und Produkten eingesetzt werden

• Discovery-Methoden und -Tools evaluieren und aufsetzen sowie Informationen aus CMDB, Code- und Netzwerk-Scans, Zertifikatsinventaren, SBOM/CBOM, Cloud-Daten und Vendor-Informationen kombinieren

• Pilotarchitekturen, Prototypen und technische Testimplementierungen entwickeln, beispielsweise für PQC- oder Hybrid-TLS, PKI- und Certificate-Lifecycle-Prozesse sowie Signatur-Use-Cases

• Wiederverwendbare Patterns, Guidelines, Referenzimplementierungen, technische Migrationsstandards und Migrationsmuster entwickeln, damit Anwendungs-, Plattform- und Infrastrukturteams PQC konsistent einführen können

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Security-/Krypto-Architekt:in in grossen IT-Umgebungen auf Senioritätsniveau (Senior, 5–8 Jahre)

• Tiefes Know-how in PKI, TLS/mTLS, HSM/KMS, Zertifikaten, Signaturen sowie Netzwerk- und API-Security

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Design von Crypto-/Key-Management-Architekturen sowie in der technischen Analyse von Infrastruktur-, Applikations- und Cloud-Use-Cases

• Fähigkeit, ein unternehmensweites Cryptographic Inventory und eine PQC-Readiness-Bewertung methodisch und technisch zu konzipieren und gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams umzusetzen

• Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau

title: Principal Implementation Engineer, Customer Support
Partenaire commercial indépendant (H/F)
description:
À propos de PropertyOS

PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique.

Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier.

Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat.

🚀 Votre mission

En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution.

Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre :

  • Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative.
  • Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition.
  • Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS.
  • Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel.
  • Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés.

Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté.

💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats

Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance.

La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus.

Le principe : valoriser concrètement les opportunités commerciales qui contribuent au développement de PropertyOS.

Les conditions précises de rémunération, les modalités d'attribution des ventes et les échéances de paiement seront communiquées avant le démarrage du partenariat.

Il s'agit d'une opportunité de collaboration indépendante, et non d'un emploi salarié. Aucun revenu minimum ni volume de ventes garanti n'est annoncé.

🎯 Le profil recherché

Nous sommes ouverts à différents parcours professionnels. Vous pourriez correspondre à ce partenariat si vous :

  • Avez une fibre commerciale et aimez créer des relations professionalnelles.
  • Vous intéressez à l'immobilier, aux logiciels SaaS ou aux nouvelles technologies.
  • Savez identifier des opportunités et communiquer clairement.
  • Faites preuve d'autonomie, de sérieux et de professionnalisme.
  • Souhaitez développer une activité indépendante en complément ou à titre princi

title: Regional Sales Director
Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

title: Mitarbeiter in der Kundenbetreuung (m,f,d)
description:
Wir suchen eine empathische und kundenorientierte Person, für den Patient:innen Support unserer Kunden. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen 35.000-42.000€ Brutto im Jahr. Die Stelle kann auch Remote durchgeführt werden.

 

Was dich in der Rolle als Mitarbeiter:in in der Kundenbetreuung erwartet

 

Als Mitarbeiter:in in der Kundenbetreuung bist du die Stimme von Nelly für Patient:innen. Mit Empathie, Klarheit und einem guten Gespür für Bedürfnisse begleitest du sie durch aufkommende Fragen. Du sorgst dafür, dass sich die Patient:innen unsere Kund:innen jederzeit gut betreut fühlen.

 

Über Nelly

Wir sind ein Tech-Unternehmen und glauben, dass sich Gesundheitsversorgung deutlich weniger nach Papierkram anfühlen sollte und viel mehr nach Menschen. Deshalb entwickeln wir Technologie, mit der medizinische Praxen einfach, effizient und ohne administratives Chaos arbeiten können.

Unsere Plattform verwandelt komplexe und zeitaufwendige Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Workflows – von der Patient Journey über Abrechnung bis hin zu modernen Zahlungslösungen. KI-gestützt, für echte Menschen gebaut und darauf ausgelegt, medizinischen Teams genau das zurückzugeben, was ihnen oft fehlt: Zeit und Fokus. Warum wir das tun? Europa steht vor einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachangestellten. Wenn wir nicht grundlegend neu denken, wie Praxen arbeiten, wird das System langfristig nicht mehr funktionieren. title: Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover
description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. About The Role

Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams.

You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live.

Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service.

  • Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence.

  • Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations.

  • Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service.

  • Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through tohan

title: VP, Finance
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

About the Role

The VP, Finance will own financial strategy, performance and capital allocation across the group and its businesses. Finance should provide a clear view of where the group is making money, where capital is being deployed and where returns can be improved.

 

What you will be doing

  • Own Group P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, budgeting and financial planning.

  • Build financial models for businesses, new products, market expansion and investments.

  • Review revenue, costs, margins, unit economics and cash requirements by business.

  • Drive capital allocation based on business performance and expected returns.

  • Own treasury, tax, audit, controls and financial reporting across Group entities.

  • Lead financing, investments, acquisitions and other transactions when required.

  • Build finance systems and teams that can support additional businesses and markets.

 

What you will need

  • Senior finance experience in technology, fintech, internet or another high-growth business.

  • Strong experience across corporate finance, FP&A and business finance.

Looking for a social media & event management internship with real responsibility?

Pausify is building a platform that brings book lovers together offline.

We started in Berlin, where thousands of people have already joined our sessions and we’ve built a community of 27K+ people on Instagram.

Now we’re taking the next step: building a platform where anyone can find or host a Pausify session nearby — in a café, park, bakery, living room, or wherever people want to meet.

Everything else — CV, previous jobs, degree — is optional.

  • Strukturierte Pflege aller Kontakte, Anfragen und Kooperationsstände in Outreach-Listen bzw. im CRM

Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst

Fachlich:

  • Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule, idealerweise in BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

title: Copy of Research Scientist / Engineer – Performance Optimization
description:
You'll make Luma's multimodal models fast — profiling and optimizing GPU, CPU, and accelerator code so they train efficiently and deploy at scale without sacrificing quality. You'll write the kernels and operations that get the most out of the hardware.

This is deep performance work: fused kernels, tensor cores, Triton and CUDA, distributed multi-node deployment. It fits someone with expert GPU-optimization skills and a deep understanding of transformer internals. If you're not at home in CUDA, Triton, and profilers, this is the wrong depth.

What You'll Own

  • Profile and optimize GPU/CPU/accelerator code for maximum utilization and minimal latency.

  • Write high-performance PyTorch, Triton, and CUDA, dropping to custom operations when needed.

  • Develop fused kernels and leverage tensor cores and modern hardware features across platforms.

  • Optimize model architectures and implementations for distributed multi-node production deployment.

  • Build performance monitoring and analysis tools and automation.

  • Research and implement cutting-edge optimization techniques for transformer models.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Profile the current training and inference paths and find the biggest performance wins.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Land a kernel or architecture optimization that measurably improves utilization or latency.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Build the monitoring and automation that keeps performance gains from regressing.

What You Bring

  • Expert-level Triton/CUDA programming and GPU optimization.

  • Strong PyTorch skills, including kernel development and custom operations.

  • Proficiency with profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, torch profiler, custom tooling).

  • Deep understanding of transformer architectures and attention mechanisms.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with compilers and exporters (torch.compile, TensorRT, ONNX, XLA).

  • Experience optimizing inferen

title: Senior UICC/eUICC/eSIM Engineer
Independent Consultant - Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance
description:
RSB – Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials is a global, multi-stakeholder organisation dedicated to driving the truly sustainable development of the bioeconomy. Frequently recognised as an industry leader in supply chain sustainability, RSB applies its best-in-class sustainability framework across sectors including aviation, chemicals, materials, and shipping.

Our small, dedicated team operates remotely from countries around the world, working collaboratively with a diverse base of member organisations, industry partners, and policymakers. For more information, please visit www.rsb.org.

Purpose of This Call

RSB now invites eligible firms and individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services described below. This Call for Expressions of Interest is not yet linked to a specific project or immediate assignment. RSB is building a pre-approved External Consultant Roster: a qualified pool of selected specialists and organisations that will be called upon for project-based work for the next 2-3 years.

We are primarily seeking to engage consultancy firms, agencies, and other established organisations, providers that can offer dedicated capacity, depth of expertise, and continuity across assignments. At the same time, we warmly welcome expressions of interest from independent consultants and other individual specialists whose qualifications and experience match the profiles sought. Throughout this document, “Consultant” refers to both firms and individuals unless stated otherwise.

Consultants accepted onto the roster will complete a brief onboarding process to become familiar with RSB’s systems, ways of working, and sustainability framework, so that engagements can begin efficiently when a relevant need is identified. When a specific project or capacity gap emerges, RSB will contact roster members whose profile best matches the assignment, share a defined scope of work, and invite them to submit a proposal.

Inclusion on the roster is an expression of readiness and fit and not a guarantee of immediate work or remuneration.

The Services

The Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance Consultant will provide regulatory compliance and sustainability assessment expertise for bio-based materials, sustainable fuels, feedstocks and related value chains. Consultants in this profile support RSB Advisory Services with the expert practical interpretation of regulatory frameworks, such as EU RED, CORSIA and relevant voluntary certification requirements, including their GHG calculation methodologies. They support feedstock eligibility, low-ILUC considerations, sustainability-risk screening, voluntary scheme benchmarking and compliance gap identification.

You’re a self-driven, highly capable recruiter who thrives in fast-moving environments and is energized by the challenge of finding talent that can build the best products. You’re deeply curious, technically fluent, and confident engaging with engineering and product candidates who are solving some of the hardest problems in AI and personalization. You are comfortable owning every part of the process and serving as a thoughtful brand ambassador from first outreach to offer. You are excited to help scale a team that’s redefining the future of ecommerce.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

Recruiting at Constructor

Constructor has grown headcount over 180% in the last two and a half years with a lean team: a small recruiting team and the support of our hiring managers. We’re excited to continue growing and to bring on a Technical Recruiter that will focus on roles across our Engineering and or Product team. These teams are distributed across North America, APAC, LATAM, and EMEA. Given the technical nature of our product, prior experience recruiting for technical roles is required. We're looking for someone excited to partner closely with hiring managers and help us scale intentionally and effectively across regions.

title: Senior Procurement Manager
description:
We are seeking a Procurement Manager to lead sourcing, supplier management, and purchasing operations while ensuring a reliable, cost-effective supply of materials that supports production, inventory, and business growth.

The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading the procurement function to ensure a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials supporting manufacturing operations. This role develops and executes procurement strategies, manages supplier performance, partners cross-functionally to support production requirements, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that optimize inventory, reduce costs, and strengthen supply chain performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and implement cost reduction initiatives while maintaining product quality and supply continuity.

  • Collaborate with Planning, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing to ensure material availability supports production schedules.

  • Analyze purchasing trends, supplier performance, and market conditions to identify opportunities for improvement and mitigate supply chain risks.

  • Manage procurement activities to optimize inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

  • Develop contingency plans to reduce supplier risk and improve supply continuity.

  • Support new product introductions through supplier sourcing, qualification, and procurement planning.

  • Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, contractual requirements, and ethical sourcing standards.

  • Provide leadership and direction for the procurement function by coaching and developing the Buyer while building a high-performing procurement organization.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve procurement processes, supplier performance, and operational efficiency.

  • Prepare and present procurement metrics, supplier scorecards, savings initiatives, and performance reports to leadership.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 6 or more years of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain experience within a manufacturing environment required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; or equivalent directly related work experience.

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating supplier agreements and managing strategic supplier relationships.

  • Previous experience leading, coaching, or developing employees, direct reports, or project teams is required.

  • Experience with MRP/ERP systems and procurement planning.

  • Strong understanding of inventory management, production planning, and manufacturing operations.

  • Proven ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategic procurement solutions.

  • Excel

London, King's Cross
Top-of-market compensation

About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to deepen our ML research capabilities in clinical oncology. This is a senior, research-oriented role for someone who wants to develop novel approaches to medical image analysis, treatment outcome prediction, and multi-modal clinical data integration - and see those methods reach real clinical settings.

You’ll work at the intersection of ML research and clinical application, collaborating closely with physicians, medical physicists, and experienced engineers with deep domain expertise. Together, you’ll develop methods that are scientifically rigorous and clinically meaningful. Your work will directly shape our product capabilities and contribute to peer-reviewed science.

What You’ll Do

Research & Method Development

  • Develop novel ML/DL methods for medical image analysis, including segmentation, lesion detection, longitudinal tracking, treatment response prediction, and outcome modeling

  • Design and conduct experiments to evaluate new approaches against clinical baselines and state-of-the-art methods

  • Stay current with the literature and propose research directions that advance Nucs AI’s product and scientific

title: Research Scientist / Engineer – Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure
description:
You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale — coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful.

RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this — post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water.

What You'll Own

  • Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs.

  • Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes.

  • Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes.

  • Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking.

  • Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable.

  • Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the current RL stack and where throughput, stability, or correctness break.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Improve a piece of the loop (rollout throughput, reward infra, or an environment) and prove it on a real run.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Harden the full loop across thousands of GPUs and asynchronous architectures.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with RL (PPO/GRPO-family, RLHF, RLVR) at meaningful scale.

  • Extensive distributed PyTorch tr

Unser Kunde ist ein spezialisierter Anbieter für Business Intelligence, Unternehmensplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung und begleitet seit vielen Jahren Unternehmen vom Mittelstand bis zum internationalen Konzern bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Finanzprozesse. Im Fokus stehen ganzheitliche Lösungen rund um Reporting, Planung, Forecasting und Konsolidierung auf Basis moderner BI Technologien. 
Gesucht wird ein Senior Consultant, der Finance Verständnis, Beratungskompetenz und analytisches Denken verbindet. In dieser Rolle begleitest du Kunden langfristig bei der Optimierung ihrer Finanz- und Controllingprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen moderne BI- und Planungslösungen. 

Dich erwartet eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem spezialisierten Consulting Umfeld.

title: Content Executive (6 month FTC)
description:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

Title: Content Executive

Department: Social / Content

Duration: 6-month freelance contract

Location: UK Remote

You will:

  • Find the strongest short-form moments inside Midnite’s existing and newly produced long-form content.

  • Edit, caption and correctly format platform-ready content in CapCut, Premiere or equivalent.

  • Treat TikTok, Reels, Shorts and X as different products, adapting the edit and packaging for each.

  • Brief our editors clearly on bigger builds using timecodes, hooks, framing and references.

  • Own the publishing schedule across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and X, planned around the football calendar.

  • Monitor performance, spot emerging or declining formats and iterate quickly.

  • Feed high-performing organic work into our paid creative pipeline.

  • Bring new formats and make them feel unmistakably Midnite.

  • Move fast and boldly while working within ASA guidelines and responsible messaging requirements.

The next Midniter:

  • Has 1–3 years of experience making and publishing short-form content, ideally across multiple brands; sport, betting or entertainment experience is a plus.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

  • Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

  • Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

title: Marketing & Growth Lead
description:
Ihre Aufgaben

Du übernimmst Marketing und Wachstum als Gesamtverantwortung und führst sie gegen klare KPIs. Du entwickelst die Marketingstrategie für Deutschland, Europa und China und leitest daraus Webseite, Kampagnen, Webinare und Paid Media ab. Du steuerst Agenturen für Ads und Brand sowie interne Ressourcen, setzt HubSpot als Pipeline-System ein und sorgst dafür, dass das Portfolio aktiv vermarktet wird. Du verantwortest außerdem die Sichtbarkeit in KI-Suchsystemen.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Marketingstrategie und Roadmap, abgeglichen mit Unternehmens-, Produkt- und Vertriebsplanung

  • Webseite auf WordPress, mit KI-gestützter Pflege, so aufgebaut, dass das gesamte Leistungsportfolio abgebildet ist

  • Paid Media auf Google, Meta und LinkedIn, mit Budgetsteuerung nach CPL, Conversion und Pipelinebeitrag

  • Webinare von der Planung bis zur Lead-Übergabe in HubSpot

  • Führung der Agenturen und Spezialisten für Ads und Brand, inklusive Budget, Termine und Qualität

  • Aufbau eines wiederholbaren Marketingsystems aus Roadmap, Briefings, Templates, Reviews und Dashboards

  • Maßnahmen für Sichtbarkeit in KI-Systemen (Generative Engine Optimization), damit wir bei relevanten Fragen zu Qualitätsmanagement gefunden und empfohlen werden

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Mehrjährige Verantwortung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise in Beratung, Industrie oder Professional Services

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in Strategie, Kampagnenführung, Leadgenerierung und Performance Marketing

  • Erfahrung, Agenturen und externe Partner zu steuern und Ergebnisse verbindlich einzufordern

  • Praxis im Umgang mit KI-Tools in Marketing, Content und Automatisierung

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder vergleichbaren CRM-Systemen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch. Chinesisch ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, klare Priorisierung und hohe Eigenverantwortung

  • Berufserfahrung im Bereich Marketing und Growth Management

  • Fundiertes Know-how in der Konzeption und Umsetzung digitaler B2B-Kampagnen

  • Analytische Stärke und ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Marketing- und Analyse-Tools

  • Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägter Blick über den Tellerrand

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Sie profitieren von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit zum Remote-Arbeiten im Homeoffice, unterstützt durch eine komplette Home-Office-Ausstattung sowie einen Firmenlaptop und ein Firmenhandy. title: Senior Tax Manager (gn)
description:
Your mission

The Bikeleasing Group continues to grow and is expanding its international tax function. As a Senior Tax Manager (gn), your initial focus will be on our tax matters in Germany. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to develop international topics and structures together with the relevant stakeholders. Close collaboration with external tax advisory firms, specialist departments, authorities and our parent company will be part of your daily work. The position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Germany and includes occasional business travel. Sounds good? Then we look forward to getting to know you.
Your tasks

  • You will manage the Bikeleasing Group’s tax matters independently, initially with a focus on Germany and increasingly on international topics in the future
  • You will prepare tax returns, tax declarations, input tax refund claims and withholding tax applications carefully and on time
  • You will be responsible for tax calculations in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) as well as the IFRS reporting package for our parent company
  • You will continuously monitor, document and optimise intra-group transfer pricing
  • You will actively contribute your expertise to VAT-related matters and tax audits
  • As the central point of contact for specialist departments, external tax advisory firms and authorities, you will provide clarity on complex tax matters
  • You will further develop international tax topics and tax processes together with the relevant stakeholders


Your profile

  • A completed degree in business administration, economics or law with a focus on taxation, or a comparable qualification
  • At least five years of professional experience in the tax department of a company or at an auditing or tax advisory firm
  • In-depth knowledge of German tax law and, ideally, international tax law
  • Practical experience with accounting in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and, ideally, knowledge of IFRS
  • Familiarity with group structures and the related accounting requirements
  • A successfully completed German tax consultant examination is desirable
  • A structured and precise approach to work, as well as confidence when dealing with authorities and external partners


Why us?

Around your working day

  • Flexible working hours and flexitime help you balance work and private life.
  • Workation: Once a year, you can work remotely from another EU country—or from a country where you hold a valid work permit—for up to three weeks.
  • You’ll receive modern equipment for working both in the office and remotely.
  • Clear vision at work matters to us. If you need prescription glasses for your workplace, we’ll contribute €100 towards the cost.

title: Talent Acquisition
description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Today our founders and hiring managers run most of the process themselves. You'll take that over end to end, from the first conversation to a signed offer, and build the hiring engine we need as we scale. You'll work closely with our Chief of Staff and every team lead.

You will:

  • Own full-cycle hiring across Engineering, GTM and Operations, from role kickoff to offer and close.

  • Source proactively for hard technical roles (Go, networking, platform, security), through GitHub, the open source community, events and your own network, instead of waiting for inbound.

  • Run the first conversation with candidates and be the person they trust throughout the process.

description:
Remote-first, Büro in Karlsruhe | ab sofort | unbefristet ab Tag eins

4.500–7.000 EUR Bruttofixgehalt pro Monat plus 1–3 % Provision auf den provisionsfähigen Ertrag deiner abgeschlossenen Aufträge. Deine Einordnung im Fixgehaltsband richtet sich nach deiner relevanten Erfahrung und der Abschlussverantwortung, die du übernimmst. Berechnungsbasis und Provisionssätze sind im Provisionsmodell transparent festgelegt.

Warum deine Mission zählt

Informationssicherheit entscheidet heute darüber, ob ein Unternehmen handlungsfähig bleibt. Unsere Kunden sind Mittelständler und KRITIS-Organisationen, die NIS2 und steigende Anforderungen nicht als Formular sehen wollen, sondern als Schutz, der trägt.

Als Andockoffizier bist du die Person, bei der aus Interesse eine Entscheidung wird. Du führst Strategiegespräche mit Geschäftsführung und IT-Leitung, schaffst Entscheidungssicherheit und bringst die Beauftragung über die Ziellinie. Andocken heißt: zwei Seiten verbinden sich fest. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Du verkaufst nicht, was ein Hersteller vorgibt. Du verkaufst, was unsere Crew wirklich umsetzt, und du kannst es auch in einem Jahr noch vertreten.

Was dich erwartet

Deine Rolle an Bord

Du übernimmst vorqualifizierte Bedarfe. Erstkontakt und Terminierung liegen bei einer Agentur oder einem anderen Crew-Mitglied, das Mehrwertgespräch führt unsere Fachseite. Wenn ein Gespräch bei dir ankommt, ist der Bedarf geprüft. Deine Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo es um die Entscheidung geht.

Strategiegespräche führen

  • Problem-, Ziel- und Nutzenbild gemeinsam mit dem Kunden schärfen

  • Entscheidungsweg, Kriterien und Beteiligte offenlegen

  • Jedes Gespräch mit bestätigtem Ergebnis und verbindlichen nächsten Schritten beenden

Abschluss steuern

  • Angebote strukturieren, Optionen klar darstellen, Einwände und Risiken offen adressieren

  • Verbindliche Entscheidungsfahrpläne mit Kunden vereinbaren, wo nötig, führst du das Entscheidungsgespräch

  • Einkauf, Laufzeiten, Leistungsumfang und Vertragspunkte verhandeln

  • Beauftragung abschließen, Kick-off vereinbaren und die Übergabe an die Umsetzung sicherstellen

Vom Einstieg zum Mandat

  • Du schließt unsere Einstiegsprodukte ab, z. B. ISO 27001-Bestandsaufnahme, NIS2-Startpaket oder CRA-Startpaket

  • Daraus entwickelst du Folgeaufträge über Mandate und Services, z. B. ISO 27001-Einführung oder NIS2-Umsetzung mit ISB-Mandat, Kryptoinventar- & SBOM-as-a-Service

Fachliche Rückendeckung

  • Bei der Lösungsarchitektur sitzt die Fachseite mit am Tisch. Du musst Technik nicht allein verkaufen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, ohne Freigabeweg über mehrere Ebene

Als PR-Redakteur und Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Strategie bis zur erfolgreichen Veröffentlichung in den Medien.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

Secure BJAK's AI-enabled products and agent workflows using third-party models. Focus on customer data shared with model providers, agent permissions, user data isolation, and prompt injection through uploaded documents and other untrusted content.

What You Will Build

  • Assess customer data sent to third-party model vendors, including minimization, vendor controls, retention, logging, and approved use.

  • Design controls limiting AI agent permissions, tools, actions, and system access using least privilege and explicit authorization.

  • Implement and test tenant and user data isolation across prompts, conversation history, retrieval, memory, and AI-connected services.

  • Threat model and test prompt injection and indirect injection through uploaded documents, retrieved content, links, and other untrusted inputs.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on safe document ingestion, content handling, output validation, and approval for sensitive actions.

  • Support SC TRM and BNM RMiT for AI technology risks, including assessments, third-party oversight, control evidence, and remediation.

  • Build security tests, monitoring, and response procedures for AI misuse, data exposure, unauthorized actions, and vendor incidents.

What We Look For

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

 

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

The Role

You’ll work closely with SPAR’s program lead, and there’s room to take on broader ownership of how SPAR supports its mentors.

title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in United Kingdom.

Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.
In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.
Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.
Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.

Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.

As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

  • Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.

  • Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).

  • Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness.

  • Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.

  • Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.

  • Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.

  • Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability.

    • Requirements

    We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment.

We're looking for an experienced Group Clinical Trials Manager to play a pivotal role in developing and delivering sponsored clinical trials across our international network of veterinary practices.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape and grow a clinical trials function within one of the world's leading veterinary groups. Working with sponsors, contract research organisations (CROs) and clinical teams across Europe and North America, you'll drive the successful delivery of pivotal clinical trials while helping to build enthusiasm and capability for clinical research throughout our network.

 


What You'll Be Doing

As Group Clinical Trials Manager, you'll take ownership of the operational delivery of multiple clinical trials, ensuring they are delivered efficiently, compliantly and to the highest standards.

 

 

Key responsibilities include:

*Managing the day-to-day operation of clinical trials across veterinary clinics
*Acting as the primary point of contact for sponsors throughout the trial lifecycle
*Building and maintaining strong relationships with sponsors and CRO partners
*Developing project plans, timelines and risk management strategies
*Recruiting and onboarding veterinary clinics into clinical studies
*Supporting and delivering GCP and protocol-specific training
*Driving study enrolment and engagement activities to maximise participation
*Providing expert guidance on protocol implementation and study delivery
*Monitoring study progress and troubleshooting operational challenges
*Managing and supporting a team of regional Clinical Trial Coordinators

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

In this role you'll;

title: Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist to own payroll processing and compliance for our workforce across the US and Europe. You will be the main contact between the company and our US EOR provider and international payroll advisors (UK, US, Poland, Portugal, Estonia, Germany). For European entities that run payroll locally, you will receive their payroll data, keep one accurate record of who sits on which entity's books, and consolidate it into group-level reporting. You will also own benefits administration, the annual renewal cycle, and pensions in every country where we operate.

The job covers more than processing. You will run live payroll cycles accurately and also improve how payroll works: writing SOPs, tightening controls, consolidating reporting, managing providers, and supporting audits. Over time you will reduce our reliance on third-party providers by moving payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, including setting up payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. You will work closely with People, Finance, payroll providers, benefits brokers, pension providers, and auditors, and you will be the person employees go to for fast, accurate answers on pay, pension, and benefits. The role is UK-based.

Responsibilities

  • Run UK and US payroll cycles from start to finish: validate all inputs (new hires, leavers, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, time off), review every payroll register, and coordinate with the US EOR and international payroll advisors.

  • Act as the main contact for European entities that run their own payroll: receive monthly payroll data, reconcile it against HRIS headcount, and keep a single accurate record of who sits on which entity's books.

  • Own statutory filings and tax portal access for UK and US payroll, and produce consolidated group payroll reporting to support month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Manager Robotic Sales Engineering (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

Robotic Sales Engineers (RSEs) are RobCo’s technical face to the customer. They qualify opportunities, run requirement workshops, check feasibility and drive each deal to a concept our Solutions Development team can build.

As Manager Robotic Sales Engineering, you lead a team of around six RSEs and report to the Head of Robotic Sales Engineering. You make sure every deal gets the right technical lead, every customer gets a consistent experience and every RSE on your team keeps getting better. You carry a quota together with Sales and are measured on whether your team hits it.

You are a player-coach. You lead the team, and you still go on-site for the deals that matter most. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help scale how RobCo brings physical AI into real production.

What you will do

  • Lead and grow the team – Hire, onboard and coach your RSEs. Run regular 1:1s, give clear feedback, write performance reviews and build real career paths.

  • Deliver the quota – Own your team’s quota together with your Sales counterparts. Track pipeline and win rates, spot deals at risk early and put your team’s capacity where it moves the number.

  • Steer the deal portfolio – Match RSEs to Account Executives and deals, balance workload and set priorities together with Sales and Delivery, so no customer waits and no deal slips.

  • Raise the quality bar – Set the standard for discovery, requirement workshops, feasibility checks and handovers. Review the critical concepts before they go to the customer or to Solutions Development.

  • Be hands-on where it counts – Join strategic accounts and complex workshops yourself, and be the technical escalation point for customers and AEs.
