  • Du hast Trends im Blick und bringst eigene Formatideen ein

Was du mitbringst

  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera und redest so, wie du mit deiner besten Freundin redest

  • Du kennst Reels und TikTok nicht nur als Zuschauer:in, sondern hast schon selbst Content erstellt

  • Du schneidest sicher mit CapCut, Edits oder deinem favorisiertem Tool

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und hältst Absprachen ein

  • Du bist eingeschrieben (Werkstudent:in) oder suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, das deine Hochschule mit ca. 10 Std./Woche über 6 Monate anerkennt

  • Ein Smartphone mit guter Kamera hast du sowieso

  • Bonus: Du interessierst dich für Hochzeiten.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung, auch rund um Prüfungsphasen

  • Flexible Remote-Arbeit mit gelegentlichen Team-Meetings in Hamburg

  • Echte Verantwortung: Deine Videos gehen live, du siehst direkt, was funktioniert

  • Feste Ansprechpartnerin und klares Feedback statt endloser Korrekturschleifen

  • Ein Portfolio, das sich sehen lassen kann

So bewirbst du dich

Wir brauchen kein formelles Anschreiben. Wir möchten den Menschen hinter der Bewerbung kennen lernen. Du darfst selber entscheiden, wie du dich am besten präsentierst. Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt bei EUR 14–18 pro Stunde.

Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
  • Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.

  • Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

title: Senior AI Researcher: LLM post-training for hallucination reduction (f/m/d)
description:
Who we are

Aleph Alpha’s mission is to deliver sovereign, human-centric AI to governmental institutions and large enterprises. To that end, we deliver category-defining AI innovation that enables open, accessible, and trustworthy deployment of GenAI in industrial applications. Our organization develops foundational models and next-generation methods that make it easy and affordable for Aleph Alpha’s customers to increase productivity in development, engineering, logistics, and manufacturing processes.

About the role

We are looking for a (Senior) AI Researcher to join our hallucination reduction capability team to push the boundaries in LLM post-training (SFT and RL).

We're one of the few places in Europe training foundation models from scratch. You will be part of a team of (senior) researchers and PhD interns doing cutting-edge research across pre-, mid- and post-training, grounding and specialized models with hundreds of GPUs at our disposal.

What will you do

  • Core Research & Development: Design, execute, and scale post-training methodologies (SFT, RL) specifically aimed at eliminating model hallucinations and making them grounded in evidence.

  • Uncertainty & Reliability: Research and implement techniques in uncertainty estimation, calibration, self-consistency, and self-correction mechanisms to enable models to identify and signal when they “don't know”.

  • Post-Training Pipelines: Build and optimize high-throughput, distributed fine-tuning and training pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters.

  • Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design and implement rigorous evaluation methods to benchmark hallucination rates, truthfulness, and reasoning accuracy.

  • Technical Ownership: Drive research projects independently from initial hypothesis to scalable production implementation and technical reports.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning or post-training LLMs using modern distributed training frameworks.

  • Track record of research or implementation in at least one of the following domains:

    • Hallucination mitigation / truthfulness alignment / grounding in RAG

    • Uncertainty estimation, or out-of-distribution detection

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation evaluation /

title: Clinical Pharmacist
description:
At Montu, we are transforming access to medical cannabis treatment across the UK, and our Clinical Pharmacists play an important role in delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are looking for an experienced Clinical Pharmacist (Independent Prescriber) to join our growing London team. This is an opportunity to use your clinical expertise in an evolving area of healthcare, working alongside a multidisciplinary team to support patients throughout their treatment journey.

Whether you already have experience in cannabis-based medicinal products or are looking to develop your knowledge in this specialist field, we offer the training and support to help you build your expertise while making a meaningful difference to patients' lives.

As a Clinical Pharmacist (Independent Prescriber), you will provide safe, effective and personalised treatment to patients with a wide range of clinical needs.

Working closely with our multidisciplinary team, you will be responsible for clinically reviewing prescriptions, prescribing appropriate treatments and providing expert clinical guidance to patients and colleagues.

You will also contribute to the development of clinical pathways, support patient and staff education and play an important role in maintaining the highest standards of clinical care.

This is a hybrid position based at our King's Cross office in London, requiring three days on site and two days working remotely.

Please note you will be required to work 1 Saturday per month onsite, for which a day in lieu will be given.

  • Clinically check and review cannabis-based medicinal product (CBPM) prescriptions to ensure safety, accuracy and appropriateness.

  • Prescribe medicines as an Independent Prescriber, tailoring treatment to individual patient needs.

  • Provide expert clinical guidance to patients and prescribers on treatment options.

  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive patient records in accordance with GPhC standards.

  • Support the dispensary team with complex clinical queries and prescribing-related matters.

  • Deliver education and training on CBPM to patients, clinicians and colleagues.

  • Collaborate with the wider Clinical and Pharmacy teams to ensure a safe and effective patient journey.

  • Contribute to the development of clinic

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role:

  • We are looking for Enterprise Account Executives.

  • This role is focused on selling into global enterprises with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions.

  • Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works.

  • Our early enterprise motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations.

  • You will be responsible for driving high six-figure opportunities and are confident that we will close the first 7 figure deals this year through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Our targets call for millions of additional ARR over the next year. You will play a major role in that.

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe.

title: Join our Talent Community
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

Zattoo Talent Community

You have the passion and desire to personally contribute to the television of the future with an Emmy award winning TV Streaming pioneer. You value flexible working. You care about the impact millions of people watching TV has on the environment. Well, congratulations, you've come to the right place and you’re already on your journey.

Founded in 2005 Zattoo is one of the leading TV streaming providers in Europe with around 3 million users per month. With headquarters in Zurich, we also have a large office in Berlin, and a team over in Ann Arbor, Michigan, in the USA. Over 200 employees contribute to the television of the future and yes, we are growing! We are pioneers in our field and wish to remain so in the years to come. That challenges us and is great fun.

We have a culture that is constantly on the lookout for new opportunities, allows mistakes to be made in learning and places good ideas above hierarchies. For us, flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely are a matter of course. We truly foster trust based working.

What is the Zattoo Talent Community?

The Zattoo Talent Community is the place where you can engage with us and let us know you would like to #jointhestreamteam but you can’t see an open position that suits you just yet. We’d love to hear from you and keep you in mind for future roles and we promise to keep in touch with you. All you have to do is two simple tasks:

  • Upload your current CV
  • Add a cover letter - this part is just as important as the CV. Let us know what kind of role you’re interested in.

And in the meantime remember to regularly check our careers page for new vacancies.

We regularly hire for:

  1. Technology - engineers, product designers, IT operations, QA, Data & Business Intelligence
  2. Commercial - Marketing & Communications and Sales & Business Development
  3. Customer - Customer Service, Implementation, Service Delivery, Project Management
  4. Central Operations - Finance, People, Workplace
  5. Students - working students position

title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
description:

Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
description:
StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care.

Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

  • Propose a data collection strategy — research suitable public and clinical data sources, recommend patient consent and other administrative requirements for ML training (e.g., data protection agreements, ethics approval), and define collection and anno

Worum es geht

Bei uns ist Kundenkommunikation nicht nur Newsletter-Versand, sondern einer der wichtigsten Wachstumshebel im Unternehmen. Wir suchen eine Person, die die Kommunikation mit unseren Kunden – von Newsletter über WhatsApp bis zum Abo-Management – steuert und damit direkten Einfluss auf Retention und Customer Lifetime Value nimmt. Du verantwortest bei uns Ergebnisse und nicht lediglich To-dos.

Ein wichtiger Teil davon ist KI: Du nutzt sie ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag – um Probleme clever zu lösen, schneller voranzukommen und mehr zu bewegen. Du probierst gern Neues aus und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • CRM-Strategie & Ownership: Du verantwortest unsere CRM- und Retention-Strategie end-to-end, entwickelst daraus eine klare Roadmap und priorisierst eigenständig die größten Hebel für Wiederkaufrate, Retention und Customer Lifetime Value.

  • Lifecycle & Flow-Automation: Du entwickelst unsere Customer Lifecycle Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiter – von Welcome und Post-Purchase über Cross-/Upselling bis Replenishment, Subscription und Winback – und baust skalierbare Automationen statt manueller Einzellösungen.

  • WhatsApp & neue Kanäle: Du baust WhatsApp-Marketing als Kanal weiter aus, gestaltest die Auswahl passender Tools mit und erschließt neue CRM-Kanäle.

  • Subscription & Retention: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern unser Subscription-Modell weiter und verantwortest CRM-seitig die Steigerung von Abo-Conversion, Laufzeit und Retention.

Das bringst du mit

Drei Dinge sind für diese Rolle die Basis: fundierte Erfahrung mit Klaviyo und Shopify sowie ein fortgeschrittener, souveräner Umgang mit KI.

  • Klaviyo: Du baust Segmente, Flows und Tests selbst und wertest sie aus

  • Self-hosting and maintaining a wide range of structured data sources — knowledge graphs (Wikidata, UniProt, Materials Project), scholarly data (OpenAlex, OpenAIRE), statistical databases (Eurostat, World Bank, IMF, OECD), open data portals and more.

  • Designing interfaces and tools to expose to the models and agents to use the services in different ways (direct YQL or SPARQL queries, or more refined and constrained MCPs to mimic external services) to support data generation and agentic training.

  • Building the data pipelines that ingest, index and serve massive datasets, including indexing our own pretraining corpora for exploration, deduplication and eval-leakage checks.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

• Familiarity with hydrogen

title: Production Engineer
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability.

Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts.

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

description:
About our client

Our client is an established software company in the field of IT security. For more than two decades, it has been developing solutions for secure digital communication – technology that reliably protects content and identities and keeps unwanted messages and malware at bay, without putting technical hurdles in the way of its users. Several thousand customers from regulated industries such as healthcare, energy, finance and insurance, public administration, pharmaceuticals and law rely on this technology.

The company is rooted in the German-speaking market and is currently growing internationally. Precision, reliability and high standards of quality shape its products just as much as the way people work together. Its core values – openness, reliability, appreciation and competence – apply within the team as much as in dealings with customers and partners.

We are happy to share our client’s name in a personal conversation.


Your mission

You will shape how several companies become one organisation.

Our client is growing – through acquisitions, through internationalisation and through building new structures across Switzerland, Germany, Denmark and further locations. This phase will not be decided by strategy, but by whether the people in our companies come along.

That is exactly what we need you for. As Director People & Culture, you will make sure the upcoming consolidation and integration steps are accepted and consistently implemented across the entire group: structures, roles, leadership, communication and the retention of the people we want to keep. You will report directly to our CEO and work closely with him.

The role is strategic and hands-on at the same time. There is no large HR apparatus behind you – you design the solution and then implement it yourself.


Your tasks and responsibilities

  • You develop the target picture of our organisation together with the CEO and the managing directors, and keep it moving forward
  • You integrate acquired companies from a people perspective: organisational structure, roles, leadership levels, compensation logic and culture
  • You build a group-wide role and job architecture and harmonise structures across borders – without overriding local realities
  • You enable our managers for phases of change, from structured performance conversations to the difficult ones
  • You own internal communication around change initiatives and advise the CEO on it
  • You develop and implement a retention strategy for key people
  • You prepare workforce adjustments and see them through in a legally sound way across all jurisdictions involved
  • You develop our HR processes and systems further, with Personio as the leading system, and build reliable reporting for the management team and the advisory board

title: (Senior) Recruiting Specialist (m/w/d) remote CH
description:
What to expect

Are you an experienced recruiter with a hands-on mindset, accustomed to end-to-end recruiting in a fast-paced, dynamic environment—from job analysis to offer closure? Have you filled technical, functional, and commercial roles, communicate confidently with hiring managers and clients, and know exactly which levers move a role to a quick, high-quality hire?

Then you’re a fit for us. We’re not looking for an administrator of open roles, but a recruiting consultant who thinks ahead, advises, and delivers.


Your tasks and responsibilities


  • You independently manage end-to-end recruiting mandates for our clients (SMEs, start-ups, scale-ups)—from requirements analysis to successful placement
  • You act as a sparring partner to our clients on job titles, job descriptions, recruiting strategies, channel selection, and market positioning
  • You conduct active search via LinkedIn Recruiter and other (AI-based) sourcing tools, proactively identifying and approaching suitable candidates
  • You carry out screening calls and qualifying first interviews in German, English, and ideally French
  • You own all candidate communication, including scheduling, candidate care, and process management in the ATS
  • You create compelling job descriptions, develop posting strategies, and implement them operationally
  • You produce project documentation, screening forms, candidate reports, and other materials for our clients
  • Where needed, you facilitate workshops and training sessions for our clients’ hiring managers and recruiters


Your profile


  • At least 5 years of recruiting experience—ideally in a start-up, scale-up, or high-volume environment with a fast pace and high autonomy
  • University degree in business administration, psychology, or a related field
  • Proven track record filling a broad spectrum of roles: technical positions (software, hardware, engineering), functional roles (HR, finance, operations), and sales & marketing positions
  • Mastery of end-to-end recruiting; accustomed to independently steering mandates from the client intake session to offer
  • Excellent active search skills and routine use of LinkedIn Recruiter; experience with AI-based sourcing tools is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with various ATS/recruiting software systems (e.g., Personio, Successfactors, or similar) and quick to get up to speed in new tools
  • Confident, consultative communication with clients and hiring managers—you recommend the right strategy, not just the fastest

Content Creator (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind die MWX Agency die Social-Media-Kanäle von Kunden aus der ästhetischen Medizin und der Beauty-Branche betreut. Gedreht wird bei mir mit dem Smartphone: schnell, nah dran und gemacht für Instagram, TikTok und Meta Ads. Bisher drehe ich selbst. Weil ich aktuell viel verhindert bin, suche ich jemanden in Hamburg, der das übernimmt.

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • 4-5 feste Drehtage im Monat bei meinen Kunden in Hamburg und Umgebung, auf Wunsch auch mehr
  • Drehen mit dem Smartphone nach Briefing und Shotlist: Reels, kurze Interviews, Behind the Scenes, Produkt- und Behandlungsaufnahmen, Event-Content
  • Eigenständig vor Ort, denn ich bin meist nicht dabei. Am Set bist du mein Auge
  • Übergabe des Rohmaterials am selben oder am nächsten Tag, sauber benannt und sortiert
  • Pflege deiner Aufgabenkarten in Notion: Status, Links, Fristen

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Du drehst sicher mit dem Smartphone und hast ein Gespür für Licht, Ton und Bildausschnitt
  • Du kennst Social-Media-Content und weißt, was in den ersten zwei Sekunden passieren muss
  • Ein eigenes aktuelles Smartphone mit guter Kamera. Mikrofon und Licht für einfache Content Creation kann ich zur Not stellen
  • Souveränes, freundliches Auftreten. Du vertrittst mich bei Ärztinnen, Ärzten und Praxisteams
  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Inhalten: Bei medizinischen Kunden gelten feste Grenzen, zum Beispiel keine erkennbaren Patienten ohne Einwilligung, keine Vorher-Nachher-Aufnahmen und keine Ergebnisversprechen. Ich erkläre dir das in der Einarbeitung, danach achtest du selbst darauf
  • Zuverlässigkeit: Ein abgesagter Drehtag kostet einen Kundentermin
  • Von Vorteil: Schnitt in CapCut oder vergleichbar, Führerschein, Englisch

Benefits

Was ich dir biete

  • 4-5 feste Drehtage im Monat, planbar mit Vorlauf, optional mehr
  • Feste Pauschale je Drehtag
  • Eine Einarbeitung: Ich zeige dir die Kunden, die Abläufe und die Vorlagen, bevor du allein drehst
  • Klare Briefings und Shotlists, kurze Wege, eine direkte Ansprechperson

So bewirbst du dich
Schick mir zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben, am liebsten Social-Content, den du selbst mit dem Handy gedreht hast. Dazu ein, zwei Sätze, wann du verfügbar bist. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

title: Data Scientist & ML Engineer - Predictive Analytics & Agentic AI
description:
We Want You to Grow With Us

Data tells stories, and this role is responsible for turning those stories into decisions. As our Data Scientist & ML Engineer, you will develop the predictive, prescriptive, and optimisation models that give Intersnack the analytical foresight to act confidently across procurement, manufacturing, and sales. You will report into the AI Programme and work alongside AI engineers and data engineers to integrate your models into the knowledge and agentic AI frameworks being built across the organisation, combining classical machine learning rigour with the emerging capabilities of large language models and intelligent agents. Intersnack is committed to growing its people as it grows its capabilities, and this role offers a unique vantage point from which to shape how AI reasoning is embedded into a global business.

What We Can Offer

You will have the opportunity to work across a wide and commercially meaningful range of modelling challenges, from demand forecasting and process optimisation in manufacturing, to procurement analytics and scenario modelling, with direct access to the business stakeholders whose decisions your models will inform. This is not a role where models sit in notebooks; your work will be operationalised, monitored, and iterated upon in production environments. You will collaborate with AI architects and engineers to integrate predictive logic into agentic workflows, giving your models a reach and impact that scales beyond individual use cases. Dusseldorf is your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and Intersnack's international footprint ensures your models will operate at genuine scale.

title: Senior Social Strategist
UX Copywriter
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.


We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint.

Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch.

You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches.

This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments.

We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch.

  • Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints, including help articles, FAQs, SEO content and operational communications.

  • Balance customer needs, business goals and regulatory requirements to create content that's clear, helpful and compliant.

  • Use customer insight, data and testing to improve the content and customer journeys.

title: Growth Analyst
description:
📍Location - this role is based in our London office 2 days per week with the remaining 3 days working remotely

Business to Consumer Partnerships is one of the most entrepreneurial teams at Goodlord, and we’re looking for a Growth Analyst to join us!

This role is all about spotting growth opportunities and making them happen. You’ll look at where we can improve broadband and media conversion, unlock the potential of smaller partnerships and build propositions for under-served tenant groups.

You’ll have real ownership from day one, using data, commercial thinking and great relationships to turn ideas into action. As the team grows, there’s a clear opportunity to take ownership of your own product vertical too.

The Opportunity:

  • Use data and insight to identify commercial opportunities and drive improvements in partner conversion and performance.

  • Build and maintain dashboards, forecasting models and trend analysis to give the team clear visibility and support decision-making.

  • Own relationships with smaller partners, identifying, testing and developing new commercial opportunities.

  • Work cross-functionally with Partnerships, Finance, Product and Commercial teams to develop propositions and improve the tenant journey.

What we need from you:

  • Experience in a commercial, partnerships, analytics or growth-focused role, with a strong track record of spotting and pursuing opportunities.

  • A natural relationship-builder who is confident working with external partners, presenting insights and challenging internal stakeholders.

  • Highly organised and proactive, with the drive to take ownership, turn ideas into action and see them through to completion.

  • Strong data and Excel/Google Sheets skills, with the ability to build models and dashboards and turn insights into clear commercial recommendations.

It would also be great if:

  • You have an interest in the tenant experience, renting or PropTech.

  • You’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • You’re confident presenting commercial ideas and backing up your thinking.

  • You have experience with SQL or BI tools.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

title: Conseiller financier pour les industries lourdes
description:
Authority développe une plateforme d’intelligence sectorielle qui associe expertise humaine et données afin d’améliorer les articles en ligne et les prévisions portant sur des résultats économiques, financiers et commerciaux.

Nous recherchons un Conseiller financier pour les industries lourdes actuellement actif sur le marché français et disposant d’informations de marché à jour. Il s’agit d’une mission de conseil rémunérée et flexible, jusqu’à 2 heures par mois.

Vos missions

  • Fournir des commentaires écrits ou enregistrés, concis, sur les évolutions récentes, les changements de marché et leurs conséquences probables.
  • Vérifier l’exactitude d’articles, de rapports et d’hypothèses de prévision, notamment concernant les dépenses d’investissement et le financement de projets, les flux de trésorerie industriels, l’exposition aux matières premières et à l’énergie, le fonds de roulement, le refinancement et les investissements industriels.
  • Expliquer les implications pratiques pour les entreprises, les investisseurs et les décideurs.
  • Contribuer à des contenus susceptibles d’être publiés par Authority et dans de grands médias professionnels.
  • Selon les besoins, envisager des missions distinctes de conseil de marché auprès d’organisations de notre clientèle.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente.
  • Activité actuelle sur le marché français et connaissance récente de ses évolutions.
  • Expérience directe de décisions financières, commerciales ou d’investissement importantes dans ce domaine.
  • Capacité à expliquer clairement et brièvement des sujets complexes.
  • Profil LinkedIn valide présentant une expérience pertinente.

Modalités

  • Contrat de conseil indépendant.
  • Mission à distance depuis la France.
  • Jusqu’à 2 heures de conseil rémunérées par mois.
  • Missions flexibles, principalement des commentaires courts et des appels occasionnels.
  • Des missions de conseil supplémentaires pourront être proposées séparément selon le profil et la demande des clients.

À propos d’Authority

Authority développe de l’intelligence sectorielle, des prévisions et des contenus fondés sur l’expertise afin d’aider les organisations à prendre de meilleures décisions stratégiques.

title: Digital Workplace Engineer
description:

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

Ons team bestaat uit acht enthousiaste recruiters die elke dag werken aan het optimaliseren van ons wervingsproces. We zoeken continu naar creatieve manieren om mensen enthousiast te maken voor werken in de zorg, zoals bijvoorbeeld banenmarkten of via zij-instroomtrajecten. Je kunt meer informatie vinden op onze website www.cordaan.nl en www.werkenbijcordaan.nl.

Binnen de Human Resources, Kwaliteit en Innovatie afdeling (HRK&I) werken meer dan 100 mensen, verdeeld over diverse teams zoals HR Advies, HR Operations, HR Expertise, Verzuim, Recruitment en Leren en ontwikkelen. Je komt dus in een grote en dynamische HR-omgeving terecht!

Je werkzaamheden als stagiar

Tijdens je stageperiode ben je verantwoordelijk voor allerlei leuke en uitdagende taken! Zoals:

→ Contact onderhouden met hiring managers en kandidaten;

→ Proactief werven middels de juiste doelgroepstrategie;

→ Vacatureteksten opstellen;

→ Assisteren bij het screenen van cv's;

→ (Telefonische) gesprekken met kandidaten voeren;

→ Kandidatenbestanden beheren;

→ Bijbehorende administratieve werkzaamheden.

Daarnaast krijg je de kans om mee te helpen met:

→ Analyseren van wervingsdata en -trends;

→ Verbeteren van de candidate experience;

→ Deelnemen aan carrièrebeurzen, wervingscampagnes en het maandelijkse event Banen en Bitterballen!


Wat bieden wij?

We bieden je een mooie kans om praktische ervaring op te doen binnen een dynamische en professionele omgeving. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, waardevolle kennis op te doen, een breed beeld te krijgen van de werkzaamheden binnen een grote HR-afdeling en een netwerk op te bouwen binnen de zorgsector. Je krijgt een stagevergoeding van €513,81 bruto per maand op basis van fulltime beschikbaarheid (36 uur per week). Bij Cordaan vinden we het belangrijk om te werken met stagiairs, omdat jullie een frisse kijk op onze processen hebben en we het geweldig vinden om talent vroegtijdig te ontdekken en te ontwikkelen. description:
Über FLOWZOOM

  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)

Support im Creator Management

  • Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:

  • Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn

  • Du filterst wiederkehrende Formate heraus: ein paar Serien, die unsere Zuschauer wiedererkennen und für die sie zurückkommen, z. B. „A vs. B"

  • Authentische Travel- und Lifestyle-Momente: das Kissen im echten Leben (Flughafen, Flugzeug, Zug, Roadtrip) – kein reiner Verkaufs-Content

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Tangible

Tangible Markets builds secondary market infrastructure for private fund LP interests. Our platforms help investors, wealth managers, fund managers and lenders buy, sell, price, finance and close secondary transactions. Our products:

Liquidity Hub: a secondary marketplace where LPs list fund interests and qualified buyers bid, with liquidity windows, tender offers and NAV lending.

Auctions: a competitive sale process for fund interests, supported by pricing models, pricing reports and market sentiment data.

Closing Platform: a transaction workflow built with a leading law firm to manage transfer documents, signatures and closing steps.

The role

You own the design of our products end to end, from research to shipped UI. You work with product, engineering and data teams on complex financial workflows used by institutional buyers, wealth advisors, lenders, fund managers and lawyers. Several products run as white-label versions for large financial partners.

Position open to candidates based in the EU and the UK.

Responsibilities

  • Own visual branding and design direction across every product, with a modern and consistent standard.

  • Lead the UX and UI revamp across the whole platform.

  • Design end-to-end flows across all products: onboarding, listings, bidding, pricing, financing and closing.

  • Turn complex financial and legal processes into clear, simple interfaces.

  • Design data-dense screens: pricing outputs, dashboards, reports, tables and comparisons.

  • Run user research and usability testing with buyers, sellers, advisors and partners.

  • Own the design system across products and white-label client versions.

  • Own the design process, including where AI tools fit to speed up research, prototyping and production.

  • Own design organization: files, handoff, and how work moves from design to build.

  • Set the quality bar and hold it. Nothing ships that has not cleared it.

  • Direct the product designer and review their output.

  • Work with engineering through build and QA so designs ship as intended.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years on complex B2B, fintech or enterprise products.

  • Deep UX skills: information architecture, interaction design, user research and usability testing.

  • Proven experience building and maintaining a design system in Figma: components, tokens, variants and documentation.

  • Daily use of AI productivity tools in design work (for example Claude, Figma AI, v0 or Cursor) to prototype and iterate fast.

  • Experience designing multi-step, multi-role workflows with permissions, statuses and approvals.

title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
description:
Résumé

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech.

Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses.

Notre culture

Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tec

title: Lead Data Engineer
BDR Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

  • We have strong product market fit. In 2025 we grew ~5x with world class net dollar retention, mostly from founder-led sales, and now have AEs hitting quota with an emerging playbook.

  • We're looking for another BDR Manager to accelerate our outbound engine as we scale in 2026. You'll own a team of ~10 BDRs and be responsible for the pipeline that fuels our growth.

  • You will report to Dave Bentham (Head of Sales) and work closely with our AEs, marketing, and leadership team to make sure the top of funnel is consistently feeding high-quality pipeline.

What You’ll Be Doing

Set the strategy

  • Translate company targets into clear, measurable BDR goals and ensure pipeline expectations are distributed strategically across the team.

title: IT-Leitung (m/w/d) für unsere Klinikkunden

Du übernimmst die IT-Leitung bei einem unserer Klinikkunden und gestaltest sie langfristig. Vom ersten Tag an, mit voller Verantwortung.

Actura übernimmt operative Führungsfunktionen in Krankenhäusern und Reha-Kliniken. Unser Anspruch: Umsetzung statt Beratung. Dafür suchen wir erfahrene IT-Führungskräfte, die bei unseren Kunden die IT-Leitung übernehmen und dauerhaft Teil der Klinik werden.

  • Du führst und entwickelst das interne IT-Team, steuerst externe Partner und ordnest Verträge und Leistungen neu, wo es nötig ist

  • Du verantwortest Informationssicherheit und Compliance: ISMS, NIS2, KRITIS und B3S, Meldewesen, Datenschutz und Prüfungen

  • Du treibst die großen Themen: KIS-Wechsel, Rechenzentrums- und Cloudmigration, Telematikinfrastruktur, Digitalisierung und KHZG

  • Du berichtest an Geschäftsführung und Gremien und arbeitest eng mit Betriebsrat, Datenschutz und den klinischen Bereichen zusammen

  • Du baust Strukturen, Prozesse und Dokumentation so auf, dass die IT dauerhaft stabil und prüfungssicher läuft

Dein Profil: Erfahrung, Haltung, Führung.

  • Du kennst die regulatorischen Anforderungen an Kliniken (NIS2, BSIG und KRITIS, B3S, DSGVO) und hast Audits und Prüfungen verantwortet

  • Du hast Budget- und Vertragsverantwortung getragen und verhandelst souverän mit Lieferanten

  • Du findest Dich schnell in neue Organisationen ein, entscheidest klar und gewinnst das Vertrauen von Geschäftsführung, Ärzten und Pflege

  • Du willst langfristig gestalten und bringst Dich vor Ort voll in die Klinik ein

Gute Gründe für Actura.

title: Accounting Expert: AI Model Evaluation
description:
About Huzzle Labs

Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance.

About the Role

Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance.

This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.

Responsibilities

  • Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books.
  • Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly.
  • Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo.
  • Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears.
  • Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.”
  • Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations.
  • Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required.
  • Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing.
  • Excellent written English and precision with numbers.
  • Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria.
  • Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension.

  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

description:
About the Role

As a Telecom Signalling Security Analyst, you will combine customer-facing delivery with hands-on technical execution in sensitive telecom environments.

You will:

  • Support and operate P1 Security solutions in production contexts (notably PTM and VKB).
  • Conduct signalling security audits using proprietary tooling (notably PTA) and deliver rigorous, professional reports and presentations to customers.

This is a profile-focused role: we are looking for someone who can cover both audit delivery and operational support.

Our teams are remote-first, with a preference for candidates who can overlap working hours with Central European Time.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer delivery & communication

  • Act as a technical point of contact for customers: scoping, updates, and delivery.

  • Deliver presentations, training, and debrief sessions.

  • Signalling Security Audits (PTA)

  • Contribute to audit scoping (objectives, perimeter, constraints, timelines, deliverables).

  • Prepare safe execution plans and operational safeguards.

  • Execute signalling security audits using PTA and associated tooling in a controlled manner.

  • Analyze results, validate findings, and assess exploitability/root cause.

  • Draft professional technical reports in English and present findings to customers.

  • PTM operations & IT support (ticket management)

  • Provide IT support for the PTM IDS in the context of customer ticket workflows.

  • Troubleshoot and maintain PTM deployments, including Linux and virtualization layers.

  • Operate and improve day-to-day tooling/scripts used for investigations, maintenance, and deployments.

  • Collaboration & continuous improvement

  • Work closely with Engineering and R&D to improve tooling, detection quality, and operational processes.

  • Maintain clear internal documentation and handover notes.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical writing (English): ability to draft professional, structured technical reports and slide decks

  • Client communication: strong verbal communication skills for presenting and interacting directly with customers.

  • Telecom core & roaming security: solid understanding of telecom core architecture, roaming concepts, and where signalling security fits in real operator environments.

  • Signalling protocols & call flows (hands-on): ability to read and reason about SS7/SIGTRAN

title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
description:
TL;DR

  • We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

  • Founding deployment strategist: you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

  • €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

title: Technical Support & Enablement Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

When a branch or market team can’t get something done in our systems, they come to you. Our teams work across a connected landscape of internal tools, from first customer contact through offer and project planning to installation and invoicing. You find out why: is it a bug, a gap in knowledge, or a missing feature? Then you make sure the right fix happens and you stay on it until the user can work again. What you see in the tickets helps us make these systems easier to use.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support branches and market teams in Germany, Australia, Sweden, Denmark, Spain, the Netherlands and Finland, in German and English
  • Diagnose each issue and deliver the matching fix: a guide or training for a knowledge gap, a bug report with reproduction steps for Engineering, a feature request with use case and impact for Product
  • Where a simple automation closes the gap for a bug or a missing feature, you build it yourself. It goes live after a review with Engineering.
  • Use ticket data and the support metrics we agree on (volume by topic, time to resolution, share of repeat requests) to find where time is lost, and propose changes
  • Improve our support setup: ticket categories, templates, routing and handover rules
  • Write and maintain help articles and run onboarding sessions for new users and new markets This role is a good starting point in our tech organisation. You work across the full system landscape and all seven markets, and you learn how Product and Engineering make decisions. From here you can develop in several directions, for example towards product operations, ownership of an internal tool, or automation and engineering.

Dein Profil

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in support, customer success or a similar role. Internships and working student positions count.
  • German
